import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Taylor

import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Vandermonde
import Mathlib.Data.ZMod.Defs
import Mathlib.Algebra.Field.ZMod
import Mathlib.Algebra.Order.Group.Int.Sum
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Polynomial
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.CancelLeads
import Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.PDeriv
import Mathlib.Algebra.Order.Archimedean.Real.Basic
import Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.Equiv
open scoped BigOperators
#check_failure Roth.normOne_le_card_mul
#check @Finset.sum_le_card_nsmul
namespace NormCardRaw
variable {σ : Type*}
theorem polynomialSupport (P : MvPolynomial σ ℤ) {B : ℝ}
    (hB : ∀ d ∈ P.support, |((P.coeff d : ℤ) : ℝ)| ≤ B) :
    (∑ d ∈ P.support, |((P.coeff d : ℤ) : ℝ)|) ≤ P.support.card * B := by
  simpa only [nsmul_eq_mul] using
    P.support.sum_le_card_nsmul (fun d ↦ |((P.coeff d : ℤ) : ℝ)|) B hB
theorem abstractBound {ι A : Type*} [AddCommMonoid A] [Preorder A] [AddLeftMono A]
    (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → A) (B : A) (hB : ∀ d ∈ s, f d ≤ B) :
    (∑ d ∈ s, f d) ≤ s.card • B :=
  Finset.sum_le_card_nsmul s f B hB
#print axioms polynomialSupport
#print axioms abstractBound
end NormCardRaw
